messages:
sylvie: Quick design check — when I hold the scrubber and change the time range preset the p95 badge detaches and briefly floats near the top-left. Happens more on 12h+ ranges. Repro: hold drag + change preset. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/scrub-detach.png

omar: Repro'd. It looks like we recompute bucket geometry synchronously and the badge position is calculated before the new layout. Causing a one-frame mismatch.

jules: UX question: should the p95 badge be anchored to the thumb or the chart bounds? Anchoring to the thumb keeps it contextual during scrubs, but it's trickier with dynamic bucket widths.

kevin: Tech approach: keep badge in an overlay layer tied to the scrubber via CSS transforms (translate3d) and update transform on pointermove. That avoids layout reads during render passes. Also animate opacity on bucket swap instead of unmount.

sylvie: Sounds good. Accessibility: when the badge moves, keyboard focus is lost. We need tabindex on the badge and an aria-live announcement for new p95 values. a11y-bot: Recommend aria-live="polite" with prefix 'Chart percentiles:' and full-unit wording (e.g., 'one hundred eighty milliseconds').

omar: I'll prototype overlay + opacity fade. Will keep virtualization intact to avoid heavy changes. Also throttle tooltip reposition to 80ms so it doesn't teleport during scrubs.

jules: Microcopy: change preset labels from '6h' to 'Last 6 hours' and update sampling toggle hover text to 'Sampling reduces compute for long ranges by approximating percentiles; disable for exact numbers.' Avoid parentheses so SR reads smoother.

a11y-bot: Microcopy note: spell out units when announced. For toggle use 'Sampling on: approximate results' / 'Sampling off: exact results' so screen readers have clear language.

kevin: Small perf idea: when a preset change occurs mid-scrub, hold previous bucket DOM nodes and crossfade to new nodes rather than unmounting. That eliminates visual detachment. We'll try 120ms fade.

sylvie: Also keyboard flow: after closing preset menu, focus should return to the opener button. Right now ESC leaves focus in a weird spot.

omar: Good catch. Will follow WAI-ARIA patterns to restore focus to the opener on close.

jules: One more accessibility nit: when users use arrow keys to step the scrubber, announce the step size and new p95. e.g., 'Scrub step: five minutes. Chart percentiles: p95 one hundred eighty milliseconds.'

a11y-bot: Recommend a small control 'Scrub by' next to the scrubber (default depends on range) with accessible labels and keyboard support. Also support Shift+arrow to accelerate by 10x and announce 'Accelerated scrub: X minutes'.

kevin: I'll open a small PR: overlay + opacity crossfade + aria-live + scrub-step control. Link when ready.

omar: Dev preview will include the overlay and aria-live node. Will post link.

sylvie: Great. Let's keep the fade short (120ms) and ensure microcopy per a11y-bot. Add a changelog line: 'Heatmap: stabilize p95 badge during preset changes and scrubbing; improve keyboard focus and screen-reader announcements.'

jules: Agreed. Thank you team :sparkles:
